def pack_mrv(H,W,maxnodes=1000000):
 grid=[-1]*(H*W);names=list(pieces);nodes=0
 def rec(rem,placed):
  nonlocal nodes
  nodes+=1
  if nodes>maxnodes:return None
  if not rem:return placed
  # choose empty cell minimizing placement options; blank allowed but defer
  best=None;bestopts=None
  for idx,v in enumerate(grid):
   if v!=-1:continue
   r,c=divmod(idx,W);opts=[]
   for n in rem:
    h,w=pieces[n]
    # any placement covering cell
    for y in range(max(0,r-h+1),min(r,H-h)+1):
     for x in range(max(0,c-w+1),min(c,W-w)+1):
      cells=[(y+i)*W+x+j for i in range(h) for j in range(w)]
      if all(grid[z]==-1 for z in cells):opts.append((n,y,x,cells))
   if bestopts is None or len(opts)<len(bestopts):best=idx;bestopts=opts
   if len(opts)==0:break
  if not bestopts:
   grid[best]=99
   ans=rec(rem,placed)
   grid[best]=-1
   return ans
  # try largest opts
  for n,y,x,cells in bestopts:
   ni=names.index(n)
   for z in cells:grid[z]=ni
   rr=list(rem);rr.remove(n)
   ans=rec(tuple(rr),placed+[(n,y,x)])
   if ans is not None:return ans
   for z in cells:grid[z]=-1
  # allow blank
  grid[best]=99;ans=rec(rem,placed);grid[best]=-1
  return ans
 ans=rec(tuple(names),[])
 return ans,nodes
